structure.unit: Denial, Suspension, and Revocation of Dealer Licenses

law.catch_line: Appeals to Court of Appeals; bond
law.text: Either party may appeal from the decision of the court under § 46.2-1577 to the Court of Appeals. These appeals shall be taken and prosecuted in the same manner and with like effect as is provided by law in other cases appealed as a matter of right to the Court of Appeals.
